name: Zucchini & Carrot Fritters
ingredients:
1/2 Zucchini, grated (about 1.5 cups)
1 large Carrot, grated (1 heaped cup)
3 tbsp Brown rice flour, or plain gluten-free flour
1/2 Red or Brown Onion OR 1 Spring Onion, chopped
1 tsp Himalayan salt
1/2 tsp Garlic powder
1/2 tsp Black Pepper, cracked
1 tsp Nutritional Yeast (optional)
1-2 tsp Water
1-2 tsp Olive Oil
Extra Olive Oil, for frying
1 lemon
directions:
1. Add all ingredients to a mixing bowl and mix until well combined with a moist and slightly sticky consistency. Add more water or flour as needed and extra spices to taste.

2. Heat olive oil in a large frying pan on high heat, then scoop 1/4 cup of mixture into the pan and flatten with a fork. Once the bottom side is firm and golden, flip it over and cook until the other side is golden too then take off heat.

3. Repeat step 2 until all the mixture is cooked.

Serve with freshly squeezed lemon juice, a leafy salad and vegan mayo or yogurt.
notes:
Add any other spices or herbs to your desired taste.

If you grate the carrots and zucchini using a grater, it will be more watery so you won’t need as much water in the mix. If you grate them with a food processor grater, then you will need the amount of water listed.

Enjoy!
